integrity: The analytic proof states the normalization and applies only to iid uniform endpoints and a uniform independent perfect matching. Finite computations corroborate exact identities, not the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Fixed degree cutoff only; invokes published minimum-degree/core theorem; no growing-degree rate or independent validation; possibility of earlier marked-Poisson generality remains.
title: Marked Poisson–Gamma limits for low-degree chords with random circular endpoints
